state.claim: The study found that remote workers were 13% more productive than their office-based counterparts.
state.cited_passage: Treatment group workers completed 13.5% more calls per shift. The authors attribute roughly 9 points of the gain to quieter working conditions and the remainder to longer effective shifts, noting that promotion rates conditional on performance fell for the remote group.

supported.instructions: Does cited_passage support the claim as stated?

criteria: Unsupported; the passage is about something else.

Fully supported; numbers and framing match.
